Missing or unindexed records are logged as exceptions with disposition (locate, reconstruct, or document loss) and signed off by the Delegated Authority Manager before the binder is closed.
Company record retention schedule, Delegated Authority Governance policy v4, and applicable state insurance record-retention requirements for underwriting files.
Underwriting and binder records retained 7 years past the last policy expiry (longer where a state requires it); retention hold applied in the archive to prevent premature deletion.
Archival completed within 30 days of run-off completion; internal governance milestone tied to binder closure.
The decision to archive and close the binder is documented in the offboarding record and signed off by the Delegated Authority Manager with Records Manager confirmation of retention application.
Notified: the Records Manager (retention), the account underwriter, finance (commission run-off), and the Delegated Authority Manager; distribution recorded on the offboarding record.
100% of the binder's document types validated as archived (agreements, every bordereaux period, audit reports, remediation evidence, policy files).
PASS = all document types archived, indexed with a retention class, and retention hold applied; FAIL = any missing document type, unindexed record, or retention hold not set.
Gaps route to the Delegated Authority Analyst to locate/reconstruct records; unrecoverable records are documented as a loss exception approved by the Delegated Authority Manager before closure.
Retention clock runs from the last policy expiry date under the binder; archive expiry dates computed per the retention schedule (7 years or the longer state requirement).
Document-inventory fields from the PAS/GRC (document type, binder year, policy count); control total = archived document count reconciled to the binder document inventory with 0 variance.
Company record retention schedule, Delegated Authority Governance policy v4, and state underwriting-file retention rules setting the minimum retention period.

answers.value: The coverholder's delegated binding authority under BAA ref DA-2026-018, to be switched off for new business from the termination effective date; population = all binding-authority permissions and named binders for this coverholder in the PAS.
Effective from the authority termination date (e.g. 01-Aug-2026); no new risks may be bound on or after this date, though existing policies run off to expiry.

The PAS binding-authority flag for the coverholder is set to inactive with the termination date; each named binder user is disabled; the change record captures who, what, and effective date. Any binder left active blocks completion.
Post-change, a control query confirms 0 open binding permissions for the coverholder and 0 new binds dated on/after the termination date; count of active binders = 0.
The termination action and confirmation query are saved to GRC under /DelegatedAuthority/<coverholder>/offboarding/ with timestamp and the approver's sign-off; retained 7 years.

Any bind attempted after the effective date is blocked by the PAS and logged as an exception; residual active permissions found in the confirmation query are escalated to the CUO for immediate closure.
The decision to cease new business binding and its effective date are documented in the offboarding record and approved by the Chief Underwriting Officer per the delegation matrix.

Notified: the coverholder (formal termination-of-new-business notice), the account underwriting team, operations, billing/commission, and compliance; recipient list stored with the offboarding record.
All binding-authority permissions and named binders for the coverholder (100%); every permission verified inactive after the change.
PASS = 0 active binding permissions and 0 new binds on/after the effective date, with CUO-approved termination on record; FAIL = any residual active permission or a bind dated after the cutoff.
Any residual permission or post-cutoff bind is escalated to the CUO and remediated same-day; the offending bind is reviewed for validity and, if outside authority, cancelled/refered.
Acceptance = binding authority set inactive from the effective date, confirmation query showing 0 active permissions, coverholder notified, and CUO sign-off captured.
Termination evidence stored in GRC under /DelegatedAuthority/<coverholder>/offboarding/ and linked to the coverholder record in the PAS.
Effective date = the authority termination date; new-business binding ceases on/after this date while in-force policies continue to run off to their natural expiry under the run-off provisions.

checklist.step: Disable binding for the terminated coverholder
checklist.value: All named binder users deactivated and the coverholder binding-authority flag set inactive from the effective date.

testing.value: Confirmation query returns 0 active binding permissions; 0 binds accepted on/after the cutoff.

checklist.step: Close out the delegated authority grid
checklist.value: Authority limits for the coverholder removed/zeroed in the PAS as of the termination date.
